description: This file defines classes and methods for encoding and assembling MAC DL-SCH PDUs, including subPDUs, for LTE/5G communication, with focus on handling multiple subPDUs, encoders, and transport block assembly.
external_methods: shared_transport_block assemble_newtx_pdu(rnti_t, harq_id_t, unsigned, const dl_msg_tb_info&, unsigned)

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu
classes.description: Represents and encodes a MAC DL-SCH PDU containing multiple subPDUs, each with headers and payloads.

classes.name: mac_sdu_encoder
classes.description: Encodes MAC SDUs into the PDU, providing buffers and encoding functions.

classes.name: dl_sch_pdu_assembler
classes.description: Manages encoding of DL-SCH MAC PDUs for transport blocks, including assembly of SDUs and control elements.

methods.name: get_sdu_encoder
methods.description: Returns a MAC SDU encoder for a specific LCID and payload size estimate.

methods.name: add_sdu
methods.description: Adds a MAC SDU to the PDU, either from span or byte_buffer.

methods.name: add_ue_con_res_id
methods.description: Adds a UE Contention Resolution Control Element to the PDU.

methods.name: add_tag_cmd
methods.description: Adds a Timing Advance Command Control Element to the PDU.

methods.name: add_padding
methods.description: Adds padding bytes to the PDU.

methods.name: assemble_newtx_pdu
methods.description: Encodes a new MAC DL-SCH PDU for transmission based on scheduler info.

methods.name: assemble_retx_pdu
methods.description: Encodes a MAC DL-SCH PDU for HARQ retransmission.
